verdict.rationale: The docs include an API reference section, with an endpoint page for fetching a web page, and code snippets throughout the guides (e.g., page.ai, sandbox.exec). Nothing shows the reference is interactive or that examples can be run in-browser, and probes found no public OpenAPI spec at the common paths. Missing for 10: evidence of an interactive try-it/playground in the API reference, runnable examples with live responses, a published OpenAPI spec, and independent corroboration.
